newsitem.title: CHINA: Typhoon Victor kills 65 in southern China.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Victor kills 65 in southern China.

text.p: The most powerful typhoon to hit China's southern Guangdong province in years killed 65 people and injured 300 early this week, state media said on Thursday.
Typhoon Victor destroyed or damaged more than 85,000 houses and flooded 280,000 hectares of crops, affecting 1.7 million people, the China Daily said.
The newspaper said total losses were estimated at more than two billion yuan ($240 million). Chinese officials said on Tuesday that losses had reached 4.8 billion yuan.
Victor, the 10th tropical storm of the year, battered more than 50 cities and counties in Guangdong province, with the cities of Shantou, Meizhou, and Shanwei hardest hit, the newspaper said.
The storm killed one person and injured 50 when it swept over Hong Kong on Saturday, cutting off air, land, and sea traffic in the city.
